newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent rebounds as NYMEX makes upside push.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent rebounds as NYMEX makes upside push.

text.p: IPE Brent futures rebounded to a fresh high, tracking an upside push on NYMEX crude and gasoline, brokers said.
Jan Brent was trading at $22.81 a barrel at 1608 GMT, just off an session high of $22.82.
"Brent held above support at $22.40 and unleaded made new highs which helped the market," said Tim Holmes of brokers MeesPierson Derivatives in London.
Dec gas oil was trading $1.25 a tonne lower at $217.75, having reached an intra-day low of $215.50.
Gas oil came under pressure by heavy selling by one particular broker on behalf of a trade customer.
"They sold 500 lots on Dec and Jan," a dealer said.
